raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return to Movement (C-Section Safe)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "gradual return to activity, core/pelvic floor rehab, build walking tolerance"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Weeks 1-2 Post-4wk (Light Only, OB cleared for walking)" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Gentle Walk + Breath & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor contractions 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          seated 90-90 hip switches 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          standing wall slides 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          cat cow (range only, no end-range stretch) 2x6..8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Short Walk + Posture and Upper Back":
        warmup:
          walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor quick flicks 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          supine shoulder openers (arms snow angel) 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          seated scapular retraction 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          ankle pumps and circles 2x10..12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Walk + Gentle Lower Body Activation":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor contractions 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          sit to stand (higher seat) 3x6..8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          standing heel raises 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          side lying clams (no band) 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walk + Mobility Flow":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor quick flicks 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          thoracic open book 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          standing wall slides 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          seated 90-90 hip switches 2x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Walk + Gentle Strength":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor contractions 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          sit to stand (chair) 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          standing heel raises 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          side lying clams 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Posture Reset + Walk":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor quick flicks 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          seated scapular retraction 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          wall supported calf stretch 2x30..45 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          gentle neck isometrics (hand resisted) 2x6..8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
  PHASE "Phase 2: Weeks 3-4 Post-4wk (Progress Light, No Abs/Heavy)" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Walk + Controlled Lower Body":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor contractions 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          sit to stand (slow eccentric) 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          standing heel raises (2s pause top) 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          standing hip abduction 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Walk + Upper Back and Arms (No Load)":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor quick flicks 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          wall push up (incline, short range) 3x6..8 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          standing wall slides 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          standing shoulder external rotation (towel squeeze) 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 6m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Walk + Balance and Hips":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor contractions 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          split stance weight shift 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          single leg balance (support as needed) 3x20..30 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          side lying clams (2s hold) 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 6m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Walk + Controlled Full Body":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor quick flicks 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          sit to stand (tempo 3s down) 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          wall push up 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          standing hip abduction 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Walk + Mobility Circuit":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          thoracic open book 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          cat cow (range only) 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          seated 90-90 hip switches 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          wall supported calf stretch 2x30..45 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          gentle neck isometrics 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 6m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Walk + Glutes and Calves":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor contractions 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          sit to stand (add pause at bottom) 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          standing heel raises (single leg assist) 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          side lying hip abduction 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 6m
  PHASE "Phase 3: Weeks 5-6 (After 6-week check: introduce gentle core if cleared)" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Walk + Gentle Core Foundations":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor contractions 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          abdominal bracing (supine, hand feedback) 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          dead bug arms only 3x6..8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          sit to stand (tempo) 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Walk + Upper Body Control":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          thoracic open book 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          wall push up 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          standing shoulder Y raise (wall support) 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          standing row isometric (towel pull) 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          calf raises 3x12..15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 8m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Walk + Hips and Balance":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          abdominal bracing 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          dead bug legs only (short range) 3x6..8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          side lying clams (2s hold) 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          split stance weight shift 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          single leg balance (eyes forward) 3x25..35 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 8m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Walk + Core and Lower Body":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor quick flicks 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          dead bug alternating arms legs (short range) 3x6..8 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          sit to stand (slow eccentric) 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing hip abduction 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Walk + Upper Body Endurance":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          wall push up (slower tempo) 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          standing shoulder external rotation (towel squeeze) 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          standing wall slides 3x12..15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          calf raises (single leg assist) 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 8m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Walk + Balance and Glutes":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          abdominal bracing 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          dead bug alternating (short range) 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          side lying hip abduction 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          sit to stand (chair) 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          single leg balance (reach to side) 3x20..30 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 8m
  PHASE "Phase 4: Weeks 7-9 (Build Capacity, Mat Only)" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Walk + Core Progressions":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor contractions 2x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          dead bug full (controlled) 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          glute bridge (neutral spine) 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          sit to stand (tempo 3s down, 1s up) 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Walk + Upper Push Pull (Bodyweight)":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          wall push up 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing row isometric (towel pull) 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing shoulder Y raise 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          calf raises (single leg) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Walk + Hips and Balance Circuit":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          dead bug full 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          side lying clams (3s hold) 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing hip abduction 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          single leg balance (clock reaches) 3x25..35 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Walk + Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge (2s pause) 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          sit to stand (slow tempo) 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing heel raises (single leg) 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dead bug full 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Walk + Upper Body Endurance":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          wall push up (feet further) 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing wall slides 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          standing shoulder external rotation (towel) 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead bug arms only 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Walk + Mixed Core and Hips":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          dead bug alternating 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute bridge march (slow) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          side lying hip abduction 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          single leg balance (reach forward) 3x25..35 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Walk + Total Body Control":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          dead bug full 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute bridge (long lever) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          sit to stand (slow) 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          wall push up 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Walk + Mobility and Posture":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          thoracic open book 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          cat cow (controlled) 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          seated 90-90 hip switches 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          wall supported calf stretch 2x40..60 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Walk + Glutes and Calves Focus":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge march 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing hip abduction 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          calf raises (single leg slow) 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dead bug alternating 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
  PHASE "Phase 5: Weeks 10-12 (Return to Moderate Intensity, Mat Only)" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Walk + Strength Endurance":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          dead bug full 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute bridge (long lever pause) 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          sit to stand (tempo) 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          wall push up (challenging incline) 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Walk + Upper Back and Core":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          standing row isometric (towel pull hard) 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          standing shoulder Y raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dead bug alternating 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          calf raises (single leg slow) 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Walk + Hips and Balance Builder":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          side lying clams (3s hold) 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          standing hip abduction 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          single leg balance (multi-direction reaches) 4x25..35 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead bug full 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Walk + Total Body":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          dead bug full 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute bridge (single leg alternating holds) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          sit to stand (slow 3s down) 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          wall push up (hardest safe incline) 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Walk + Posture and Mobility":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          thoracic open book 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          cat cow (controlled) 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          seated 90-90 hip switches 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          wall supported calf stretch 2x45..60 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Walk + Hip Drive and Core":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge march (longer holds) 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          standing hip abduction 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead bug alternating 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          single leg balance (eyes forward, steady) 4x30..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Walk + Strength Consolidation":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          dead bug full 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute bridge (long lever pause) 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          sit to stand (tempo) 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          wall push up (challenging) 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Walk + Core and Upper Mix":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          abdominal bracing 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dead bug alternating 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          standing row isometric (towel pull hard) 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf raises (single leg slow) 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Walk + Recovery Flow":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          thoracic open book 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          cat cow (gentle) 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          seated 90-90 hip switches 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          diaphragmatic breathing 2x8..10 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor contractions 2x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 10m
